'''Galca''', officially the '''State of Galca''', is a country mainly located in [[South Mahea]], with a relatively [[small island]] chain in [[East Mahea]]. It borders the [[Adrad Sea]] and [[Isnti]] to the north; [[Ocaun]] to the west; the [[Gulf of Ale]] to the east; and the [[Praosia Sea]] to the South. Galca is home to over 16 million people; most are [[ethnic Galcan,]] while [[Ocunese]] are the largest ethnic minority. Officially a secular state, Galca has a Galcan-majority population. [[Dherkiv]] is Galca's capital and second-largest city. [[Altepso]] is its largest city and economic centre. Other major cities include [[Bergadni]], [[Tserunja]], and [[Dindaroch]]. 

First inhabited by modern humans during the Late Palaeolithic, present-day Galca was home to various ancient peoples. The [[Anaspan peoples|Anaspans]] were assimilated by the [[Dlermans]] and other Galcan peoples. Classical Galcan transitioned into cultural Earuhty after Cuvala the Great's conquests. The Yaddan Hepdans began migrating into the [[Galcan Peninsula]] in the 5th century, starting the [[Yadification process]]. The [[Hepdan Empire]] was founded in 576, or more traditionally in 1623, after the conquest of [[Kuhn]]. The [[Empire of Hepdan]] ruled Galca until the [[Darahm Sunm]] invasion in 692. Beginning in 873, the [[Smasdan Zaridai]] united the peninsula and expanded. 

In the 13th to the mid 17th centuries, persecution of _____ during the [[Ocunese annexation]] resulted in large-scale loss of life and [[mass migration]] into modern-day Isnti. After the Treaty of the Globe and [[Easuhuran-Ocunese Convention]], the peninsula was granted to [[Easuhura]] in 1638, and later given to Emara after the [[Great Imperial War]], during which the Galcan government [[committed genocides]] against its Ocunese subjects. Following the Red War, the nation was given independence in 1705, Galca emerged as a more [[wikipedia:Nation_state|homogenous nation-state]]. The [[wikipedia:/Constitutional_monarchy|constitutional monarchy]] was proclaimed on 29 October 1708, modelled on the reforms initiated by its founder and first [[Yilloccur]]. Galca remained neutral during most of the [[Cold War]].

Galca is a [[wikipedia:Least_developed_countries|low-income]] and [[wikipedia:Developing_country|developing country]]; its economy is the world's [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|110th-largest by nominal]] and [[List of countries by GDP (PPP)|103rd-largest by PPP-adjusted GDP]]. As the [[97th-largest electricity producer]] in the world, Galca aims to become a hub for regional energy transportation. It is a Unitary [[wikipedia:Constitutional_monarchy#Executive_monarchy_versus_ceremonial_monarchy|semi-constitutional monarchy]], though the [[The National Assembly|National Assembly]] has been suspended since 1762, where [[Mucar of Galca|Mucar]] has been ruling unopposed. Galca is a founding member of the [[MPU]], though is now an Observer, [[DIW]], and the [[Organisation of Yaddan]]. With a geopolitically significant location, it has one of the high military spending as a portion of GDP. It may be recognised as an emerging [[wikipedia:Regional_power|regional power]]. 

Galca has [[wikipedia:Coastal_plain|coastal plains]], a high central plateau in the south, and a very flat area in the north. Galca's climate is very heterogeneous, with most of the climate being [[wikipedia:Oceanic_climate Oceanic|climate]], with the northern area being a [[wikipedia:Humid_subtropical_climate|humid subtropical climate]]. Galca is highly vulnerable to [[wikipedia:Climate_change|climate change]], with many areas being below sea level. Galca has a [[wikipedia:Universal_health_care universal|healthcare system]], growing access to education, and increasing levels of innovativeness. With numerous [[Global World Heritage sites]] and intangible cultural heritage inscriptions, and a rich and diverse cuisine.
